text:
mika: heads-up — we've been seeing long tail queuing blow up on saturn-region for the new chat workload. 99p token latency > 6s and the queue depth is spiking.
amar: saw alerts. is this the short sequence workload or long-history chat? any correlation with quantized models?
mika: mostly short seq but bursty. seems to coincide with an uptick in concurrent sessions from mobile clients. not model-related; same model config.
zoe: what are we currently doing when a pool saturates? immediate reject or accept-into-queue?
raul: current prod policy: accept-into-queue up to 2k tokens in the scheduler window; then soft-degrade (drop batched priority) then reject. config snippet:
raul: ```yaml
admission:
  max_inflight_per_pool: 500
  max_queue_ms: 4500
  queue_capacity_tokens: 2000
  overflow_policy: soft_degrade_then_reject
```
amar: that chain is fine in steady state but it amplifies latencies under bursts — queueing keeps holding requests instead of letting clients fast-fail and retry elsewhere.
sre-oncall: the tradeoff is client experience vs wasted GPU cycles. rejects push load back to clients (good) but might increase retries and overall request volume.
zoe: proposal: test two variants for 1 hour on saturn: a) aggressive fast-fail (reject at 200ms queue time) b) prioritized backlog (short tasks get preferential queue slots, long requests get routed to slowpath). can we A/B by customer cohort?
mika: +1. prefer A/B by route tag: mobile vs web vs batch so we can see tail behavior.
raul: quick metrics to track: p50/p90/p99 token latency, total GPU token/sec, retry rate (client-side 429->retries), cost per token.
amar: suggested policy payload for fast-fail:
amar: ```json
{"admission_policy":"fastfail","reject_after_ms":200,"fallback":"route-to-dedicated-if-available"}
```
zoe: and backlog policy:
zoe: ```json
{"admission_policy":"prioritized-queue","priority_rules":[{"route":"short","weight":3},{"route":"long","weight":1}],"max_queue_ms":3000}
```
ops-bot: deploy plan created: `rollout/admission/2032123456-fastfail-backlog-experiment` — will run 1%->10%->30% ramp if no error spikes.
sre-oncall: add a kill-switch to revert to current policy if p99 tokens increase >15% or GPU utilization drops by >30% (indicates wasted retries).
raul: also add a metric for downstream error codes — if we see client-timeouts increase we need to pause.
mika: can someone own the dashboard for the run and call the rollout? I can be on watch but need someone to press revert.
amar: i'll own the dashboard and alert rules. i'll also add a synthetic load that mirrors mobile burst pattern.
zoe: thanks. one more ask: add a log tag `admission-expt=fastfail` or `admission-expt=backlog` so we can filter traces easily.
mika: good call. ops-bot — please annotate traces.
ops-bot: annotated.
raul: okay kicking off 1% fast-fail vs 1% backlog in saturn now. will post results in this thread in 30m.
mika: cheers. if we see client retry storms we abort immediately. :thumbsup:
